ai_summary: Sepia Investments Limited, Sage Investment Trust, and Anchor Partners, acting in concert, have collectively divested 4.29% of Corona Remedies Limited's equity shares through open market sales. This substantial transaction reduces their combined stake from 13.41% to 9.12%, representing a notable shift in institutional ownership. While not from the promoter group, this significant offloading could signal a portfolio rebalancing or shift in investor sentiment for the company.
